_doc: KAM digest demo + eval data. Merchants here are extra key accounts for other KAMs (scope tests); the support seed's key accounts 102, 104, 108 belong to kam@example.com. Meeting day_offset is relative to the run day, times are local (config timezone). Feed published_days_ago is relative to now. Feed items carry extra fields (internal_id, author_email) that the tool must never return; one item is not from a fixed source and one hides an injection.
